title: East Nashville Mega House | 2 Homes for LG Groups
description:
Perfect for large groups! This listing consists of two separate homes that are side by side, and can host up to 24 total guests! 
When you book this listing, you'll be receiving access to both homes. In the heart of East Nashville, this unit is a short walk to some coffee shops, stores, and Southern Grist Brewery.  It's also a 5-10 minute drive to Downtown and Broadway– this unit is complete with 11 beds, rooftop deck, grill, outdoor TV, fully stocked kitchen, and enough parking for 8 vehicles!
